SELECT 
  p.property_id,
  p.property_name,
  COALESCE(p.owner_name, 'Owner') as owner_name,
  p.owner_contact,
  COALESCE(p.preferred_platform, 'telegram') as preferred_platform,
  p.customer_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.property_id = p.property_id AND b.check_in_date = CURRENT_DATE AND b.booking_status = 'confirmed'), 0) as checkins_today,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.property_id = p.property_id AND b.check_out_date = CURRENT_DATE AND b.booking_status = 'confirmed'), 0) as checkouts_today,
  0 as open_tickets
FROM property_configurations p
LIMIT 50

SELECT 
  p.property_id,
  p.property_name,
  p.owner_contact,
  COALESCE(p.preferred_platform, 'telegram') as preferred_platform,
  p.customer_id,
  b.booking_id,
  COALESCE(b.guest_name, 'Guest') as guest_name,
  b.check_in_date
FROM property_configurations p
LEFT JOIN bookings b ON p.property_id = b.property_id
  AND b.check_in_date = CURRENT_DATE
  AND b.booking_status = 'confirmed'
LIMIT 50

SELECT 
  p.property_id,
  p.property_name,
  p.owner_contact,
  COALESCE(p.preferred_platform, 'telegram') as preferred_platform,
  p.customer_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.property_id = p.property_id AND b.booking_status = 'confirmed' AND b.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'), 0) as total_bookings,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM bookings b WHERE b.property_id = p.property_id AND b.booking_status = 'confirmed' AND b.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'), 0) as total_revenue,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.property_id = p.property_id AND b.booking_status = 'confirmed' AND b.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) as new_bookings_week
FROM property_configurations p
LIMIT 50
